standard.name: Accessibility Code of Pakistan
standard.companion: Design Manual and Guidelines for Accessibility 2006 (ADVISORY)
standard.rounding_rule: minima round DOWN, maxima round UP, so unit conversion can never turn a fail into a pass
standard.note: As of 2026 no Khyber Pakhtunkhwa statute binds this Code. Findings are departures from a minimum standard, not legal violations.

requirements.code_value: 48 in min
requirements.note: Code also requires handrail protection where level drop from adjoining ground exceeds 18 in.

requirements.code_value: 48 in min except at doors
requirements.checklist_value: 36 in min, may narrow to 32 in for max 24 in
requirements.note: Checklist narrowing allowance has no Code equivalent.

requirements.code_value: if width < 60 in, provide 60 x 60 in passing spaces at intervals not exceeding 100 ft
requirements.note: Different mechanism entirely. Corridor intersection counts as passing space.

requirements.code_value: 80 in min
requirements.note: Checklist value appears under landscape planting; Code sets it for the whole accessible route.

requirements.code_value: gradient less than 1:20 is level access
firm, slip-resistant, reasonably smooth, especially under wet conditions
requirements.note: Code names wet conditions explicitly.

requirements.code_value: detectable tactile surface across full width at each level change and at head and foot of ramps and steps
requirements.checklist_value: tactile blocks in sidewalk and crossing
requirements.note: Code is more specific about placement.

requirements.code_value: a sole accessible route must also serve as means of emergency egress or connect to an area of refuge
requirements.note: New item required.

requirements.code_value: 48 in min; 36 in clear at identified obstructions
should not exceed 1:12
no parallel bars; apertures at right angles to travel, not larger than 1 in wide
requirements.note: New item required.

requirements.code_value: all marked crossings shall have curb ramps and detectable floor paving
requirements.checklist_value: curb ramp where route crosses curb; level differences over 19 mm
requirements.note: Checklist 11.49 uses 19 mm, the only metric value in an otherwise imperial document; no Code basis found.

requirements.code_value: auditory signals and manually operated traffic lights where possible in high pedestrian traffic areas
requirements.note: Checklist states it as a requirement; Code phrases it as 'where possible'. Downgrade severity.

requirements.checklist_value: at least 10 ft wide, 4 in white lines
requirements.note: No Code basis. Check Design Manual before citing.

requirements.code_value: should not exceed 1:20; shall not exceed 1:12 for new construction
requirements.checklist_value: 1:12 max; 1:8 for rise <= 3 in, 1:10 for rise <= 6 in where space limited
requirements.note: Code gives no space-limitation exception for new build. Checklist exceptions are ADA-derived.

requirements.code_value: up to 1:8 permitted for existing development ONLY where an alternative stepped approach is also provided
requirements.note: Requires new-vs-existing site attribute and a conditional threshold.

requirements.code_value: 1:50 max
requirements.note: Minor numeric difference; adopt Code.

requirements.code_value: 48 in min
36 in min with passing space at landings
requirements.note: Exterior and interior differ in the Code; the checklist uses one value for both.

requirements.code_value: max rise between two landings 30 in
requirements.note: New item required.

requirements.code_value: single run shall not exceed 48 ft
requirements.note: New item required.

requirements.code_value: passing space provided at landings (undimensioned)
requirements.checklist_value: 60 in long, ramp width; 60 x 60 in at direction change
requirements.note: Code does not dimension landings. Check Design Manual.

requirements.code_value: handrails required unless gradient is less than 1:20
requirements.checklist_value: handrails both sides if rise > 6 in
requirements.note: Different trigger: rise-based vs gradient-based.

requirements.code_value: balustrade required where drop to the side exceeds 18 in
requirements.note: New item required.

requirements.code_value: not more than 6 in
max riser 7 in
requirements.note: Three different values across the two documents. Resolve with consultant.

requirements.code_value: not less than 11 in
requirements.note: Code 6.2.3(iii) says 'head width', read as tread.

requirements.code_value: not less than 36 in
requirements.note: Checklist records the measurement but sets no pass criterion.

requirements.code_value: min 42 in clear between handrails (low-rise buildings)
single steps should be avoided
requirements.note: 'Should' - preferred standard, not mandatory.

requirements.code_value: not less than 30 in, not more than 42 in
requirements.note: Checklist range sits inside Code range; a 32 in rail passes Code, fails checklist.

requirements.code_value: not less than 30 in, not more than 48 in
requirements.note: Code is markedly wider. Adopt Code; note the divergence in the report.

requirements.code_value: circular or oval, max 2 in dia at grip; no lower bound
requirements.note: Code sets no minimum. Retain checklist minimum as advisory.

requirements.code_value: circular or oval only
requirements.note: Code effectively disallows non-circular profiles; checklist dimensions them.

requirements.code_value: extend min 12 in beyond step or ramp, horizontally, at each end
requirements.checklist_value: extend 12 in beyond top and bottom

requirements.code_value: fixed min 1.5 in from wall surface
max 72 in between parallel handrails
requirements.note: New item required.

requirements.code_value: outdoor: at least one side. Accessible stair/ramp: both sides
requirements.applied_value: both sides interior, one side min exterior
requirements.note: Code is weaker outdoors.

requirements.code_value: ends shall be rounded and not become hazardous as protruding objects
under 20 spaces: none required. 20-50: at least 1. Over 50: min 2 percent
requirements.note: Materially different. At 100 spaces: checklist 4, Code 2. Below 20 spaces the Code requires none.

requirements.code_value: not less than 12 ft total, inclusive of a 48 in access aisle
requirements.note: Checklist totals 13 ft; Code totals 12 ft with a narrower aisle.

requirements.code_value: a 48 in aisle may be shared between two adjacent spaces
requirements.checklist_value: two spaces may share an aisle
1 van space per 6; 11 ft + 5 ft aisle, or 8 ft + 8 ft
requirements.note: Van-accessible space is an ADA concept with no Code equivalent.

requirements.code_value: 50+ combined m/cycle and cycle spaces: 1 reserved. Over 50: min 4 percent. Width not less than 6 ft
requirements.checklist_value: scooter space 4 x 5 ft, 3 ft gap
requirements.note: Code has scoping and a wider space; checklist has different dimensions and no scoping.

requirements.code_value: indoor accessible parking min height clearance 8 ft
requirements.note: New item required.

requirements.code_value: reserved spaces located in clear view of and nearest to the accessible entrance
requirements.checklist_value: access aisles adjoin an accessible route
requirements.note: Code adds proximity and visibility, not just connectivity.

requirements.code_value: at least one floor of a multi-storey indoor parking facility served by accessible lift or ramp
clearly identified on the ground surface with internationally accepted markings
requirements.checklist_value: sign with ISA, bottom min 60 in above ground; ground marking not required
requirements.note: Direct contradiction: checklist says ground marking not required, Code requires it.

requirements.code_value: not less than 33 in clear, and 80 in high, opening in direction of travel
requirements.note: Code also sets door height, which the checklist omits.

requirements.code_value: 33 in when approached at an angle; 30 in when approached straight on
requirements.note: Approach-dependent threshold; needs a conditional.

requirements.code_value: at least 30 in clear
level change at threshold shall not exceed 0.75 in
requirements.note: Threefold difference. Adopt Code as the pass threshold; note checklist value as preferred.

requirements.code_value: not less than 38 in, not more than 42 in; lever-type handles
requirements.note: Code is much narrower and mandates lever handles explicitly.

requirements.code_value: unobstructed space min 12 in adjacent to door handle on leading face
requirements.checklist_value: 18 in beyond latch side plus 60 in clear depth
requirements.note: Different measurement basis.
No Code basis. Requires a pressure gauge; consider dropping from MVP.

requirements.code_value: toilet doors to accessible compartments shall invariably open out
requirements.note: Code mandates outward swing; checklist only dimensions the inward case.

requirements.code_value: kick plates not less than 10 in high
requirements.note: New item required.

requirements.code_value: revolving doors shall not be considered accessible; automatic swing doors shall not open against direction of travel
requirements.note: New item required.

requirements.code_value: frameless glass doors avoided unless prominently marked
36 x 48 in for stationary wheelchair; 48 x 48 in for both forward and side approach
requirements.note: Checklist uses the ADA 30 in figure throughout.

requirements.code_value: 60 in diameter circle
requirements.checklist_value: 60 in circle or T-shape in 60 in square
requirements.note: Code does not mention the T-shaped alternative.

requirements.code_value: forward reach 16 in min to 48 in max; over an obstruction max 20 in; side reach 10 to 52 in
requirements.checklist_value: operable parts no higher than 48 in
requirements.note: Code sets a lower bound the checklist omits.

requirements.code_value: white cane zone extends 48 in across and 28 in in height
requirements.checklist_value: protrusions max 4 in; leading edge 27 in or lower, or 80 in or higher
requirements.note: 27 in vs 28 in detection height.

requirements.code_value: at every floor where toilets are provided, at least one accessible toilet for male and female
requirements.checklist_value: at least one accessible toilet, per sex or unisex
requirements.note: Code requires this per floor, not per building.

requirements.code_value: at least 60 in wide clear space in both directions; smaller toilets shall have door opening outside
18 to 20 in above floor level
requirements.checklist_value: 17 to 19 in to top of seat
requirements.note: Ranges overlap only between 18 and 19 in.

requirements.code_value: 18 to 21 in from centre line to adjoining wall
requirements.note: RANGES BARELY OVERLAP. A 17 in installation passes the checklist and fails the Code. Highest-priority resolution.

requirements.code_value: European type water closet; back support if un-coupled
requirements.note: Code adds the back-support requirement.

requirements.code_value: reachable Muslim shower shall be provided at the adjoining wall
requirements.note: Locally significant requirement entirely absent from the ADA-derived checklist.

requirements.code_value: not less than 24 in
requirements.checklist_value: 42 in side wall, 36 in rear wall
requirements.note: Code sets a much lower floor. Retaining the checklist value is defensible but must be disclosed.

requirements.code_value: shall extend 2 in away from the wall
requirements.checklist_value: 1.5 in space between wall and bar

requirements.code_value: external diameter between 1 and 2 in; plastic covered preferred over chrome; slightly corrugated surface recommended
requirements.note: New item required.

requirements.code_value: bottom of mirror not more than 40 in above floor level
all operable parts and controls of fixtures within 40 to 48 in above floor level
requirements.note: Code sets a lower bound.

requirements.code_value: wall mounted with lever handle controls; insulated and concealed hot water pipes
requirements.checklist_value: front max 34 in; 27 in knee clearance, 8 in deep
requirements.note: Code specifies type and safety, checklist specifies geometry. Merge; neither supersedes the other.

requirements.code_value: 24 in pull bar on inside; lockable inside, releasable from outside in emergency; spring or gravity closing hinges
requirements.note: New item required; the emergency-release provision is a safety requirement.

requirements.code_value: clear dimension 48 x 48 in; horizontal grab bar and folding waterproof shower seat preferred
in all multi-storey buildings at least one accessible lift serving all accessible floors
requirements.checklist_value: elevators or platform lifts to all public storeys

requirements.code_value: min clear width 30 in; sliding or outward opening
requirements.note: LULA is an ADA category with no Code equivalent.

requirements.code_value: switches and controls not more than 48 in above floor level
requirements.checklist_value: 15 to 42 in, or up to 48 in for parallel approach
requirements.note: Code sets no lower bound; retain 15 in as advisory.

requirements.code_value: talking and Braille signs in addition to regular signs
requirements.checklist_value: raised characters and Braille on car controls
requirements.note: Code requires audible announcement, not merely tactile marking.

requirements.code_value: size such that it accommodates at least one wheelchair user with an attendant (undimensioned)
requirements.checklist_value: 54 in deep x 36 in wide, 16 sq ft min
requirements.note: Code is qualitative. Check Design Manual for the dimension.

requirements.code_value: cab floor slip-resistant; walls resistant to wheelchair damage
a freight elevator shall not be considered an accessible lift
requirements.note: Disqualifying condition; affects NA logic.

requirements.code_value: recommended height 42 in above floor level
requirements.checklist_value: operable parts no higher than 48 in
requirements.note: Code phrases 42 in as a recommendation, not a limit.

requirements.code_value: pull knobs for ceiling switches not more than 40 in above floor
minimum character height 3 in for accessibility signage
requirements.note: Significant gap. Checklist covers Braille placement but never character size.

requirements.code_value: directional and guidance signs supplemented with Braille where within reach
requirements.checklist_value: Braille and tactile between 900 and 1500 mm, ideal 1050 mm
requirements.note: Checklist Chapter 1 is the only metric section in the document; no Code basis for the figures.

requirements.code_value: signs shall be illuminated internally or externally
requirements.note: New item required.

requirements.code_value: min 5 foot-candle (55 lux) at all times; general illumination preferably 10 to 20 foot-candle (110 to 220 lux)
requirements.note: Requires a light meter in the tool kit. Significant addition to the instrument.

requirements.code_value: on power failure, illumination maintained by emergency supply for the duration the space is occupied
2 percent of seats reserved for wheelchair users
requirements.checklist_value: table 4-25:1, 26-50:2, 51-150:4, 151-300:5, with a note stating 5 percent
requirements.note: Checklist is internally inconsistent: its note says 5 percent, its table yields roughly 2.7 to 8 percent.

requirements.code_value: designated wheelchair spaces should where possible be paired
36 in wide clear space in front of first row or behind last row
requirements.checklist_value: 36 in wide; 48 in deep front/rear entry; 60 in side entry
requirements.note: Different aspects; merge rather than choose.

requirements.code_value: the stage or activity area shall be accessible

requirements.checklist_value: at least 5 percent, no fewer than one
requirements.note: No Code basis for dining seating percentage.

requirements.code_value: counter tops 30 to 33 in high; depth not more than 21 in; clear knee space underneath
requirements.checklist_value: 28 to 34 in dining; max 36 in service counter
requirements.note: Code range is narrower and adds a depth limit.

requirements.code_value: shelves and storage between 12 and 48 in above floor level
requirements.checklist_value: displays max 36 in; overhead shelves above 49 in; dispensers max 48 in
requirements.note: Code sets a lower bound the checklist lacks.

requirements.code_value: all exposed hot water pipes under sinks and counters shall be insulated and concealed
requirements.note: Safety requirement absent from the checklist.

requirements.code_value: one accessible egress per 5,000 sq ft gross floor area, or occupant load of 50, or 100 ft travel distance, whichever is most stringent
requirements.note: Major gap. Checklist has four qualitative questions where the Code has a computation.

requirements.code_value: fire-protected construction; operable on emergency power for at least 30 minutes; egress signage; illuminated
requirements.checklist_value: is the lift an evacuation lift
requirements.note: Checklist asks yes/no; Code gives four testable criteria.

requirements.code_value: at least 1 foot-candle (11 lux) at floor level; on failure, emergency supply for 30 min at min 0.1 foot-candle (1 lux)
auditory and visual signals covering the entire accessible space
requirements.checklist_value: alarms have flashing lights and audible signals
requirements.note: Code adds full coverage.

requirements.code_value: area of refuge required in all multi-storey buildings and low-rise with 5,000 sq ft accessible floor area; must hold two wheelchairs with attendants; communication to managerial station; tactile door handle warnings
requirements.note: Entire concept absent from the checklist. Multiple new items.

requirements.code_value: written rescue assistance plan required; copy to on-site staff and to the government evacuation agency; drill at least once every year
requirements.note: Checklist has no frequency and does not ask for the plan document.

requirements.code_value: in hospitals and buildings for persons requiring mobility assistance, an accessible ramp for egress should be considered
requirements.note: Sector-gated to Health.

requirements.code_value: existing privately owned public-use buildings under 2,500 sq ft gross floor area are exempt
requirements.note: Gating condition. Requires site ownership type, gross floor area and new/existing attributes.

requirements.code_value: all government-owned or government-occupied buildings covered irrespective of size, location or use
requirements.note: No exemption path for government buildings.

requirements.code_value: mandatory requirements (total compliance new, achievable existing) vs preferred standards (voluntary)
requirements.note: Maps directly onto item severity weighting. Chapter 4.3 assigns mandatory/preferred per building type.

requirements.code_value: low-rise: 50 percent of ground floor units. Multi-storey: 10 percent of total units. Hotels: 10 percent of guest rooms
requirements.note: Percentage scoping the checklist never asks about.

requirements.code_value: existing buildings modified to an achievable extent within economic capacity
requirements.note: Softens findings for existing buildings; affects recommendation wording, not the threshold.

requirements.code_value: resting facilities at intervals between 100 m and 200 m, adjacent to but outside the accessible route
requirements.note: Metric in an otherwise imperial Code.

requirements.code_value: textural and colour changes in floor surface to identify street furniture

at least one unisex accessible toilet per public toilet location, with wash basin, European WC, grab bars, running water, workable illumination; large enough for one wheelchair user plus attendant of either gender
requirements.checklist_value: sector category exists but no items
requirements.note: Public Toilet is one of the twelve sectors but the checklist provides no dedicated items.
